reflections.lesson:
The agent never opened the event editor — that's the core failure. In Simple Calendar Pro's month view, tapping a day only selects it (steps 31/34 stayed in MainActivity); after selecting 2023-10-22 you must tap the floating "+" button (bottom-right) to open the New Event screen.

1. Stop waiting/reopening: from step 7 on, MainActivity was already foreground — waits and re-opens did nothing. Act on the visible screen.
2. Verify the month header reads "October 2023" after swiping; blindly swiping right 7 times can overshoot. Swipe one month at a time and check the title.
3. Tap the target day (its number in the grid), then tap the "+" FAB to open the New Event form.
4. In the form: type the title, open the Description field and type the text, tap the start time and set 18:00, set the end time to 18:30 (or duration 30 min), confirm date is 2023-10-22.
5. Save with the checkmark/disk icon in the top action bar, then confirm the event appears on Oct 22.
6. Avoid tapping unlabeled indices that exited to the launcher/resolver (steps 2–5); choose controls by their visible label/icon.
